verdict.rationale: Supabase documents an official MCP server in depth. Coverage includes tool groups for database, debugging, edge functions, account management, docs and branching, plus URL-level read_only, project_ref and features scoping, a local CLI endpoint, and per-agent setup for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others. Hands-on probes confirm a live OAuth-gated endpoint at mcp.supabase.com that publishes granular scopes. Missing for 10: no hands-on authenticated tool call beyond the initialize handshake, and the server is still labeled 'Beta' (branching tools experimental, PAT mode requires all scopes).
